sourceNotes.rawContent:
Go bigger, go bolder — our Large Spiral Texture Chunky Hoop Earrings feature the same gorgeous concentric swirl pattern as our small version, scaled up for a more dramatic, fashion-forward look. The oversized crescent silhouette is a true style statement.
- 316L Stainless Steel — rust-proof, tarnish-proof & skin-safe
- Gold-plated finish — rich, long-lasting shine
- Waterproof & sweat-resistant — built for everyday wear
- Large concentric spiral texture — maximalist design
- Oversized chunky hoop — bold yet comfortable all-day
Pairs with: Solid kurtas, co-ords, blazers, sarees, and fusion outfits.
Stainless steel is highly durable and water-resistant. Avoid prolonged exposure to harsh chemicals and perfumes.
